original_title: Before Mina the Hollower, Yacht Club paused a 3D Shovel Knight game that's 'not far from being showable' and a possible next project
summary_en: Before diving headfirst into the charming world of **Mina the Hollower**, **Yacht Club Games** had a fully playable, 3D **Shovel Knight** adventure in the works. This ambitious project was put on hold to fully commit resources to **Mina**, but it remains a strong contender for the studio's next endeavor.
ai_analysis: This revelation offers a fascinating glimpse into **Yacht Club Games**' development process, highlighting the tough decisions indie studios face and the potential for a beloved franchise to return in a brand-new dimension.

en.title: Yacht Club Games Paused a 3D Shovel Knight Game That's 'Almost Showable'
en.summary: Before diving headfirst into the charming world of **Mina the Hollower**, **Yacht Club Games** had a fully playable, 3D **Shovel Knight** adventure in the works. This ambitious project was put on hold to fully commit resources to **Mina**, but it remains a strong contender for the studio's next endeavor.
en.body:
## A Familiar Knight in a New Dimension

Fans of **Yacht Club Games** have long adored the pixel-perfect platforming and charming characters of the **Shovel Knight** universe. While the studio has been diligently crafting the top-down adventure **Mina the Hollower**, it's now come to light that a full 3D **Shovel Knight** game was once in active development. This ambitious project was paused, not due to creative roadblocks, but to consolidate the studio's efforts behind **Mina the Hollower**, a move that allowed for a more focused and robust development cycle for the new IP.

> "We're going to want to stick together, no matter what we do," Sean Velasco, co-founder of **Yacht Club Games**, explained in a recent interview. This philosophy led the team to pause the 3D **Shovel Knight** game, which Velasco described as being halfway through development and "not far from being showable" when it was put on ice. The studio found that splitting into multiple teams, while successful for some, wasn't the ideal approach for their tight-knit creative process. This decision allowed them to pour all their energy into **Mina the Hollower**, which, despite its own development hurdles, is now shaping up to be another impressive offering from the acclaimed indie developer.

## The Road to Mina and Beyond

**Mina the Hollower** represents a significant shift for **Yacht Club Games**, moving from the side-scrolling action of **Shovel Knight** to a top-down perspective reminiscent of classic **Zelda** titles. The game's development has been a learning experience, with Velasco noting that **Mina** initially lacked some of the studio's more experienced developers and required certain areas to be completely rebuilt. However, the team's perseverance has paid off, with Velasco expressing optimism about their development pace once **Mina** is complete and supported.

This focus on **Mina the Hollower** doesn't mean the 3D **Shovel Knight** game is lost forever. The fact that it was paused rather than canceled, and that it was reportedly in a near-showable state, strongly suggests it's a prime candidate for a future project. The prospect of exploring the **Shovel Knight** world through a 3D lens, complete with the polish and charm we've come to expect from **Yacht Club Games**, is incredibly exciting for fans who have followed Sir Knight's adventures across multiple platforms.

## What's Next

With **Mina the Hollower** nearing completion and its marketing and support phases underway, **Yacht Club Games** is poised to revisit its paused 3D **Shovel Knight** project. While no official timeline has been announced, the studio's commitment to sticking together and their current development momentum suggest this new dimension for the beloved knight could be closer than we think.

tr.title: Yacht Club Games, 3D Shovel Knight Oyununu Durdurdu: 'Almost Showable' Seviyesindeydi
tr.summary: Yacht Club Games, Mina the Hollower oyununu tamamlamak için 3D Shovel Knight oyununu durdurdu. Ancak bu oyun, stüdyonun yeni bir projeye dönüştürebileceği bir durumdaydı.
tr.body:
## Bir Yenisine Giriş

Yacht Club Games hayranları, Shovel Knight universe'nun piksel-perfect platforming ve çekici karakterlerini uzun süredir sevmektedirler. Stüdyo, top-down macera Mina the Hollower'u yaratırken, şimdi ortaya çıktı ki tam 3D Shovel Knight oyunu aktif geliştirme sürecindeydi. Bu projeyi durduran, yaratıcı engeller yerine, Mina the Hollower'un geliştirme döngüsünü odaklamak için stüdyonun tüm kaynaklarını toplamak oldu.

> "Her ne yaparsak, birlikte kalacağız," Sean Velasco, Yacht Club Games'in kurucusu, yakın zamanda yapılan bir röportajda açıkladı. Bu felsefe, 3D Shovel Knight oyununu durdurmasına yol açtı, Velasco oyunun yarıda bırakıldığını ve "gösterilebilir" seviyesinde olduğunu belirtti. Stüdyo, birden fazla ekibe bölünmek yerine, yaratıcı sürecini daha sıkı bir şekilde yönetmek istediğinden bu kararı aldı. Bu karar, Mina the Hollower'a tüm enerjiyi vermek için onlara izin verdi. Oyunun geliştirme zorluklarına rağmen, şimdi Yacht Club Games'in ödüllü bağımsız geliştiricisi olarak görünen başka bir etkileyici sunum haline geliyor.

## Mina ve Sonra

Mina the Hollower, Yacht Club Games için önemli bir değişiklik temsil ediyor, Shovel Knight'tan yana kayan bir perspektife geçiyor. Oyunun geliştirme süreci, Velasco'nun Mina'nın ilk başta stüdyonun daha deneyimli geliştiricilerinden bazılarını kaybetmiş olduğunu ve bazı alanların tamamen yeniden inşa edilmesini gerektirdiğini belirtmesiyle karakterize edildi. Ancak takımın kararlılığı, Velasco'nun Mina'nın tamamlanması ve desteklenmesi durumunda geliştirme hızının artacağına dair iyimserliğini yansıtıyor.

Bu odak, 3D Shovel Knight oyununu kaybetmek anlamına gelmiyor. Oyunun durdurulduğu yerde bırakıldığı ve neredeyse gösterilebilir bir durumdayken, bu oyun, stüdyonun yeni bir projeye dönüştürebileceği durumdaydı. Shovel Knight dünyasını 3D bir perspektifle keşfetmek, Yacht Club Games'in Shovel Knight'ın maceralarını çeşitli platformlarda izlemiş olan hayranlar için heyecan verici bir prospect.

## Gelecek

Mina the Hollower'un tamamlanması ve pazarlama ve destek aşamalarının başlamasıyla, Yacht Club Games, durdurulan 3D Shovel Knight projesine geri dönme olasılığını güçlendiriyor. Ancak resmi bir zaman çizelgesi henüz açıklanmadı. Stüdyonun birlikte kalma felsefesi ve mevcut geliştirme momentumu, bu yeni boyutu sevdikleri şövalyenin daha yakında gerçekleşebileceği anlamına geliyor.

es.title: Yacht Club Games Pone en Suspensión un Juego de Shovel Knight en 3D 'Casi Listo para Muestra'
es.summary: Antes de sumergirse en el encantador mundo de Mina the Hollower, Yacht Club Games trabajaba en una aventura de Shovel Knight en 3D completamente jugable. Este ambicioso proyecto fue puesto en espera para centrar los recursos en Mina, pero sigue siendo un contendiente fuerte para su próximo proyecto.
es.body:
## Un Caballero Familiar en una Nueva Dimensión

Los fans de Yacht Club Games han admirado durante mucho tiempo la plataforma perfecta de píxeles y los personajes encantadores del universo de Shovel Knight. Si bien la empresa ha estado trabajando diligentemente en la aventura de arriba a abajo de Mina the Hollower, ahora se ha revelado que un juego de Shovel Knight en 3D estaba en desarrollo activo. Este ambicioso proyecto fue suspendido, no debido a obstáculos creativos, sino para consolidar los esfuerzos de la empresa detrás de Mina the Hollower, lo que permitió un ciclo de desarrollo más enfocado y robusto para el nuevo IP.

> "Queremos mantenernos juntos, sin importar lo que hagamos," explicó Sean Velasco, co-fundador de Yacht Club Games, en una reciente entrevista. Esta filosofía llevó al equipo a suspender el juego de Shovel Knight en 3D, que Velasco describió como estando a la mitad de su desarrollo y "no muy lejos de ser presentable" cuando se congeló. La empresa encontró que dividirse en múltiples equipos, si bien fue exitoso para algunos, no era la mejor aproximación para su proceso creativo apretado. Esta decisión les permitió enfocar todos sus esfuerzos en Mina the Hollower, que, a pesar de sus propias dificultades de desarrollo, está empezando a ser otra impresionante oferta del desarrollador indie aclamado.

## La Ruta a Mina y Más Allá

Mina the Hollower representa un cambio significativo para Yacht Club Games, pasando de la acción de lado a lado de Shovel Knight a una perspectiva de arriba a abajo reminiscente de los clásicos títulos de Zelda. El desarrollo del juego ha sido una experiencia de aprendizaje, con Velasco notando que Mina inicialmente carecía de algunos de los desarrolladores más experimentados de la empresa y requería que ciertas áreas fueran completamente reconstruidas. Sin embargo, la perseverancia del equipo ha dado sus frutos, con Velasco expresando optimismo sobre su ritmo de desarrollo una vez que Mina esté completa y apoyada.

Este enfoque en Mina the Hollower no significa que el juego de Shovel Knight en 3D esté perdido para siempre. El hecho de que se suspendió en lugar de cancelarlo, y que se informó que estaba en un estado casi presentable, sugiere fuertemente que es un candidato primario para un próximo proyecto. La perspectiva de explorar el mundo de Shovel Knight a través de una lente de 3D, completo con la pulcritud y encanto que hemos llegado a esperar de Yacht Club Games, es increíblemente emocionante para los fans que han seguido las aventuras del caballero Sir Knight en múltiples plataformas.

## Próximos Pasos

Con Mina the Hollower cerca de su completado y sus fases de marketing y apoyo en marcha, Yacht Club Games está listo para reexaminar su proyecto de Shovel Knight en 3D suspendido. Si bien no se ha anunciado un calendario oficial, el compromiso de la empresa de mantenerse unida y su actual ritmo de desarrollo sugieren que esta nueva dimensión para el caballero querido podría estar más cerca de lo que pensamos.

content_raw: In a new interview with Bloomberg , Yacht Club Games co-founder Sean Velasco talked about Mina the Hollower's $20 price tag and the game's "make or break" status for the indie institution. Along the way, he talked about Mina's development challenges, one of which might just be the studio's next game. The immediate future is still Mina-shaped, including support and marketing for the top-down Zelda homage. After that, though? It sounds like a return to Shovel Knight is in the cards, specifically a 3D game the studio was initially developing alongside Mina the Hollower before consolidating all of its resources behind the 2D adventure game. Velasco characterized the new Shovel Knight as having been halfway through development and "not far from being showable" when Yacht Club pressed pause. From what Velasco said, it sounds like Mina the Hollower was actually the more troubled project, lacking some of the studio's more experienced developers at first and needing some areas to be completely rebuilt. Splitting the studio into multiple teams, a move that has worked out well for other companies like Obsidian , sounds like it wasn't the right fit for Yacht Club. "We're going to want to stick together, no matter what we do," Velasco said of the studio's future. Even though that means making games one at a time, he still sounded optimistic about Yacht Club's future pace of releases. “At the end of Mina we were cooking, and it was great,” said Velasco. “If we could just be doing that in perpetuity, that’s all we would need. Then the games wouldn’t take so long.” I would definitely agree that they were cooking: I backed Mina the Hollower on Kickstarter before I was even full time at PC Gamer, and I've been loving it on my Steam Deck.
